import datetime
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime

# Very large time delta (1 million days)
large_delta = datetime.timedelta(days=10**9)
print('naturaldelta(large):', naturaldelta(large_delta))

# Very small time delta
small_delta = datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1)
print('naturaldelta(small):', naturaldelta(small_delta))

# Large negative delta
print('naturaldelta(-large):', naturaldelta(-large_delta))
"
